findings.title: Table widget feature flag renders a hardcoded empty table
findings.body: When the organization has the use-table-widget-visualization feature, tableResultComponent ignores the actual tableResults entry and renders TableWidgetVisualization with columns=[] and tableData containing empty data and empty meta. Every dashboard table for such an organization will therefore appear blank regardless of the query results, loading state, fields, or title. The real result data must be converted and passed to the new visualization instead of the hardcoded empty placeholder.

findings.title: Error and breadcrumb timestamps are compared in different units
findings.body: fetch_error_details stores the error event timestamp as a Unix timestamp in seconds, while recording-segment events from rrweb carry timestamps in milliseconds. gen_request_data directly compares error_events[error_idx]['timestamp'] with event['timestamp'], so virtually every error will compare as earlier than the first breadcrumb and all errors will be emitted at the start instead of in chronological order. Normalize both timestamps to the same unit before sorting and interleaving.

findings.title: Browser report validation does not require exactly one of age or timestamp
findings.body: The serializer makes both age and timestamp optional and only rejects them when the other field is truthy via self.initial_data.get(...). A report with neither field is accepted even though it conforms to neither supported Reporting API format, and a report with age=0 or timestamp=0 together with the other field also passes because 0 is falsy. This allows malformed reports to be counted as valid. Enforce presence of exactly one field using key presence rather than truthiness.

findings.title: Hidden span attributes are only hidden while searching
findings.body: HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES is checked only inside the filter that runs when searchQuery is non-empty. When the search box is empty, sortedAndFilteredAttributes returns the sorted attributes unchanged, so is_segment, project_id, and received are still displayed by default and disappear only after the user starts typing a search. Apply the hidden-attribute exclusion before or independently of the search-text filter.

findings.title: Assemble analytics are recorded before the feature-flag check
findings.body: The endpoint records the preprod_artifact.api.assemble analytics event before checking organizations:preprod-artifact-assemble and before validating the request body. Requests from organizations without the feature, which return 404, and malformed requests, which return 400, are therefore counted as artifact assembly events and pollute downstream analytics. Move analytics.record after the feature and validation checks, ideally only for requests that actually proceed toward assembly.

findings.title: Issue titles are inserted unescaped into a Markdown link
findings.body: MERGED_PR_SINGLE_ISSUE_TEMPLATE interpolates the issue title directly into link text as [**{title}**]({url}). Issue titles are derived from error data and can contain closing brackets or Markdown link syntax, so a title containing a sequence such as ](https://example.invalid) can break out of the intended link, corrupt the PR comment formatting, or substitute a misleading destination. Escape or strip Markdown link delimiters from the truncated title before formatting the template.
